ViewObject.SQLQuery: /* Formatted on 7/4/2021 3:22:53 PM (QP5 v5.287) */ SELECT NVL (Gonah.GOZEYA_ENTITY_NAME, Genayat.GOZEYA_ENTITY_NAME) GOZEYA_ENTITY_NAME, NVL (Genayat.PARENT_ENTITY_NAME, Gonah.PARENT_ENTITY_NAME) PARENT_ENTITY_NAME, GONAH_PRISON, GONAH_PENALTY, GENAYAT_DONE, GENAYAT_NOT_DONE, PREV_GONAH, CURR_GONAH, PREV_GENAYAT, CURR_GENAYAT, TOTAL_GONAH, TOTAL_GENAYAT, AMN_DOAWLA FROM ( SELECT COUNT (FD.ID) TOTAL_GONAH, PAREN.id, PAREN.ENTITY_NAME GOZEYA_ENTITY_NAME, master.ENTITY_NAME PARENT_ENTITY_NAME FROM EXC_FOLDER_DATA FD, ENTITY master, ENTITY GOZEYA, ENTITY PAREN WHERE FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = GOZEYA.ID AND GOZEYA.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = PAREN.ID AND PAREN.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = Master.ID AND FD.CRIMINAL_TYPE = 1 AND (FD.YEAR = :year OR :year IS NULL) AND ( FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID IN (SELECT id FROM entity WHERE PARENT_ENTITY_ID = :gozeyaIdBind) OR master.ID = :gozeyaIdBind) GROUP BY PAREN.ID, PAREN.ENTITY_NAME, Master.ENTITY_NAME) Gonah FULL OUTER JOIN ( SELECT COUNT (FD.ID) TOTAL_GENAYAT, GOZEYA.ID, GOZEYA.ENTITY_NAME GOZEYA_ENTITY_NAME, GOZEYA.ENTITY_NAME PARENT_ENTITY_NAME FROM EXC_FOLDER_DATA FD, ENTITY GOZEYA, ENTITY PAREN WHERE FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = GOZEYA.ID AND GOZEYA.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = PAREN.ID AND FD.CRIMINAL_TYPE = 2 AND (FD.YEAR = :year OR :year IS NULL) AND ( (FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = (SELECT PARENT_ENTITY_ID FROM entity WHERE id = :gozeyaIdBind)) OR (FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = :gozeyaIdBind)) GROUP BY GOZEYA.ID, GOZEYA.ENTITY_NAME, PAREN.ENTITY_NAME) Genayat ON Genayat.id = Gonah.id FULL OUTER JOIN ( SELECT COUNT (FD.ID) GONAH_PRISON, PAREN.id FROM EXC_FOLDER_DATA FD, ENTITY master, ENTITY GOZEYA, ENTITY PAREN WHERE FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = GOZEYA.ID AND GOZEYA.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = PAREN.ID AND PAREN.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = Master.ID AND (FD.YEAR = :year OR :year IS NULL) AND ( FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID IN (SELECT id FROM entity WHERE PARENT_ENTITY_ID = :gozeyaIdBind) OR master.ID = :gozeyaIdBind) AND FD.CRIMINAL_TYPE = 1 AND FD.FOLDER_TYPE = 2 AND ( FD.CREATED_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE ( :createdDateBind, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AND TO_DATE ( :createdDateToBind, 'dd/mm/yyyy') + 1 OR TO_CHAR (FD.CREATED_DATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') = :createdDateBind) GROUP BY PAREN.ID) tab1 ON tab1.id = gonah.id FULL OUTER JOIN ( SELECT COUNT (fd.ID) GONAH_PENALTY, PAREN.ID FROM EXC_FOLDER_DATA FD, ENTITY master, ENTITY GOZEYA, ENTITY PAREN WHERE FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = GOZEYA.ID AND GOZEYA.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = PAREN.ID AND PAREN.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = Master.ID AND (FD.YEAR = :year OR :year IS NULL) AND ( FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID IN (SELECT id FROM entity WHERE PARENT_ENTITY_ID = :gozeyaIdBind) OR master.id = :gozeyaIdBind) AND FD.CRIMINAL_TYPE = 1 AND FD.FOLDER_TYPE = 3 AND ( FD.CREATED_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE ( :createdDateBind, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AND TO_DATE ( :createdDateToBind, 'dd/mm/yyyy') + 1 OR TO_CHAR (FD.CREATED_DATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') = :createdDateBind) GROUP BY PAREN.ID) tab2 ON Gonah.ID = TAB2.ID FULL OUTER JOIN ( SELECT COUNT (FD.ID) GENAYAT_DONE, GOZEYA.ID FROM EXC_FOLDER_DATA FD, ENTITY GOZEYA, ENTITY PAREN WHERE FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = GOZEYA.ID AND GOZEYA.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = PAREN.ID AND (FD.YEAR = :year OR :year IS NULL) AND ( (FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = (SELECT PARENT_ENTITY_ID FROM entity WHERE id = :gozeyaIdBind)) OR (FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = :gozeyaIdBind)) AND FD.CRIMINAL_TYPE = 2 AND FD.FOLDER_TYPE = 1 AND ( FD.CREATED_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE ( :createdDateBind, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AND TO_DATE ( :createdDateToBind, 'dd/mm/yyyy') + 1 OR TO_CHAR (FD.CREATED_DATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') = :createdDateBind) GROUP BY GOZEYA.ID) TAB3 ON GENAYAT.ID = TAB3.ID FULL OUTER JOIN ( SELECT COUNT (FD.ID) GENAYAT_NOT_DONE, GOZEYA.ID FROM EXC_FOLDER_DATA FD, ENTITY GOZEYA, ENTITY PAREN WHERE FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = GOZEYA.ID AND GOZEYA.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = PAREN.ID AND FD.CRIMINAL_TYPE = 2 AND FD.FOLDER_TYPE = 2 AND (FD.YEAR = :year OR :year IS NULL) AND ( (FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = (SELECT PARENT_ENTITY_ID FROM entity WHERE id = :gozeyaIdBind)) OR (FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = :gozeyaIdBind)) AND ( FD.CREATED_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE ( :createdDateBind, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AND TO_DATE ( :createdDateToBind, 'dd/mm/yyyy') + 1 OR TO_CHAR (FD.CREATED_DATE, 'dd/mm/yyyy') = :createdDateBind) GROUP BY GOZEYA.ID, GOZEYA.ENTITY_NAME, PAREN.ENTITY_NAME) tab4 ON TAB4.ID = GENAYAT.ID FULL OUTER JOIN ( SELECT COUNT (fd.ID) PREV_GONAH, PAREN.ID FROM EXC_FOLDER_DATA FD, ENTITY master, ENTITY GOZEYA, ENTITY PAREN WHERE FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = GOZEYA.ID AND GOZEYA.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = PAREN.ID AND PAREN.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = Master.ID AND (FD.YEAR = :year OR :year IS NULL) AND ( fd.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID IN (SELECT id FROM entity WHERE PARENT_ENTITY_ID = :gozeyaIdBind) OR Master.id = :gozeyaIdBind) AND FD.CRIMINAL_TYPE = 1 AND FD.CREATED_DATE BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS ( TRUNC ( TO_DATE ( :createdDateBind, 'dd/mm/yyyy')), -12) AND ADD_MONTHS ( TRUNC ( TO_DATE ( :createdDateToBind, 'dd/mm/yyyy')), -12) GROUP BY PAREN.ID, PAREN.ENTITY_NAME, Master.ENTITY_NAME) tab5 ON gonah.ID = TAB5.ID FULL OUTER JOIN ( SELECT COUNT (fd.ID) CURR_GONAH, PAREN.ID FROM EXC_FOLDER_DATA FD, ENTITY master, ENTITY GOZEYA, ENTITY PAREN WHERE FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = GOZEYA.ID AND GOZEYA.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = PAREN.ID AND PAREN.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = Master.ID AND (FD.YEAR = :year OR :year IS NULL) AND ( fd.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID IN (SELECT id FROM entity WHERE PARENT_ENTITY_ID = :gozeyaIdBind) OR Master.id = :gozeyaIdBind) AND FD.CRIMINAL_TYPE = 1 AND FD.CREATED_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE ( :createdDateBind, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AND TO_DATE ( :createdDateToBind, 'dd/mm/yyyy') GROUP BY PAREN.ID, PAREN.ENTITY_NAME, Master.ENTITY_NAME) tab7 ON gonah.ID = TAB7.ID FULL OUTER JOIN ( SELECT COUNT (FD.ID) PREV_GENAYAT, GOZEYA.ID FROM EXC_FOLDER_DATA FD, ENTITY GOZEYA, ENTITY PAREN WHERE FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = GOZEYA.ID AND GOZEYA.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = PAREN.ID AND FD.CRIMINAL_TYPE = 2 AND (FD.YEAR = :year OR :year IS NULL) AND ( (FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = (SELECT PARENT_ENTITY_ID FROM entity WHERE id = :gozeyaIdBind)) OR (FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = :gozeyaIdBind)) AND FD.CREATED_DATE BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS ( TRUNC ( TO_DATE ( :createdDateBind, 'dd/mm/yyyy')), -12) AND ADD_MONTHS ( TRUNC ( TO_DATE ( :createdDateToBind, 'dd/mm/yyyy')), -12) GROUP BY GOZEYA.ID) TAB6 ON GENAYAT.ID = TAB6.ID FULL OUTER JOIN ( SELECT COUNT (FD.ID) CURR_GENAYAT, GOZEYA.ID FROM EXC_FOLDER_DATA FD, ENTITY GOZEYA, ENTITY PAREN WHERE FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = GOZEYA.ID AND GOZEYA.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = PAREN.ID AND FD.CRIMINAL_TYPE = 2 AND (FD.YEAR = :year OR :year IS NULL) AND ( (FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = (SELECT PARENT_ENTITY_ID FROM entity WHERE id = :gozeyaIdBind)) OR (FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = :gozeyaIdBind)) AND FD.CREATED_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE ( :createdDateBind, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AND TO_DATE ( :createdDateToBind, 'dd/mm/yyyy') GROUP BY GOZEYA.ID) TAB8 ON GENAYAT.ID = TAB8.ID FULL OUTER JOIN ( SELECT COUNT (FD.ID) AMN_DOAWLA, PAREN.ID FROM EXC_FOLDER_DATA FD, COURT_BC_HEARING_RES_PARTIES RES, COURT_BC_HEARING_RESERVATION HR, ENTITY master, ENTITY GOZEYA, ENTITY PAREN, BUSINESS_CASE BC WHERE RES.ID = FD.RES_PARTY_ID AND FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID = GOZEYA.ID AND GOZEYA.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = PAREN.ID AND PAREN.PARENT_ENTITY_ID = Master.ID AND FD.CRIMINAL_TYPE = 1 AND (FD.YEAR = :year OR :year IS NULL) AND ( FD.POLICE_STATION_ENTITY_ID IN (SELECT id FROM entity WHERE PARENT_ENTITY_ID = :gozeyaIdBind) OR master.ID = :gozeyaIdBind) AND RES.COURT_BC_HEARING_RES_ID = HR.ID AND HR.BUSINESS_CASE_ID = BC.ID AND BC.CASE_TYPE = 10 GROUP BY PAREN.ID) TAB9 ON Gonah.ID = TAB9.ID
